content: Originally founded by the dutch, the first island to be settled was this, the dwarvish settlement of New Ampsterhold. As the other cities around New Ampsterhold began to thrive and look to one another for common governance,  Glaswegian Elves (Commonly called Weegies) came to an accord with the dwarvish mayoral council to found a single city made up of the 5 boroughs. Here at the heart of Empire, all of the other boroughs refer to the isle of Manhattan as simply "The City." They say the this solar punk metropolis has a true name inscribed by the dwarves and enchanted by the elves. But it's location remains a closely guarded secret.
The City is a Metropolis. It is wildly diverse, with its own city sized neighborhoods. It is crisscrossed by canals above the city, and a deep warren of jackalope built subways.

Verdant greenery grown by the Elves sits atop monumental towers of stone erected by masters of masonry and stone work. At night, it's lights glimmer on the inky black Hudson river. During the day, Airships above, steam powered paddle boats and sail boats below crisscross in an ever changing murmuration. Gliders and gondalas, submarines and skiffs, The City is defined by the motion of it's people.
The great boulevards, Wall and Broadway are the seats of wealth and entertainment for all of the colonies.

Deep below the city vast leylines converge, making it a veritable volcano of magical power. This fact makes The City the economic and engineering marvel that it is. It also makes for an ideal place to for the rebellion's minute men to make their last stand against the forces of King George's airship armada.
